title: DUTRA OS technical audit
statement: Audit of the actual DUTRA OS code/data paths used to establish current-state risks and assets before architecture work.

title: DeskcommCRM reverse engineering
statement: Open-source CRM studied as an engineering reference; patterns were extracted together with limitations and NOT CONFIRMED areas rather than copied wholesale.

title: DUTRA OS × DeskcommCRM gap analysis
statement: Capability-by-capability comparison used to separate useful patterns from unnecessary complexity.

title: DUTRA OS Architecture V1
statement: Approved architectural direction: evolve incrementally, use canonical relational truth and individual identity while preserving differentiated commercial UX/intelligence.

title: DUTRA OS Master Implementation Plan
statement: Turns Architecture V1 into small reversible packages across Foundation and Commercial Product tracks.

title: Implementation Package 01 report
statement: Foundation Bootstrap & Safety Gate implementation report including tests, environment blockers, rollback and intentionally deferred behavior.

title: DUTRA Builder Brain design review
statement: Structured review identified adoption, semantic validation, proportionality, metrics, provenance, human indexing and license-triage improvements for Builder Brain.

title: Package 00R reconciliation and release baseline
statement: Package 00R reconciled the GitHub baseline with advisory artifacts, contained XLSX risk, hardened local and Cloudflare state APIs, installed Builder Brain governance and established CI and release gates.
